sections.installation: Upload the gaffer-search folder to wp-content/plugins/ and activate it. The theme defines its indexes in config/search.php through Gaffer; the plugin builds them in the background. It writes its endpoint config to wp-content/gaffer-search/, so that folder must be writable by PHP.
sections.faq:
Does it work with multisite? Yes: every site of a network has its own indexes, secrets and endpoint config.

Where are the release notes? On the GitHub release for each version, and in docs/migration.md (shipped with the plugin) for what a site changes after an update.
